mapper.select:
SELECT
,f.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url FROM gc_user_message m LEFT JOIN sys_file f on m.file_id=f.id WHERE (m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND m.master_id = #{masterId} ) OR (m.user_id = #{targetUserId} AND m.target_user_id = #{userId} AND m.master_id = #{masterId} ) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM gc_user_message WHERE (user_id = #{userId} AND target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND master_id = #{masterId}) OR (user_id = #{targetUserId} AND target_user_id = #{userId} AND master_id = #{masterId}) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

select u.id as user_id,ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name,ui.last_name,COUNT(if(m.target_user_id=#{teacherId},TRUE,NULL)) as messageNum from gc_user u LEFT JOIN gc_user_message m ON m.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id WHERE 1=1
AND u.id in
#{userId}
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY messageNum asc
ORDER BY messageNum desc

select count(1) from gc_user_message um
left join gc_user_access ua on ua.user_id = um.user_id and um.master_id = ua.master_id left join gc_group g ON JSON_CONTAINS(g.group_access_ids, CONVERT(ua.id, char))=1 and g.master_id = um.master_id
where um.target_user_id =#{targetUserId} and um.master_id =#{masterId} and um.read_state =0
and g.id=#{groupId}
